title: Careers: pharmaceutical water engineering jobs | Aquemi
meta: Process, orbital welding (ASME IX), validation, controls, field service and quality jobs on PW and WFI systems in Canada. Pay range in every posting.
eyebrow: CAREERS · ENGINEERING · WELDING · VALIDATION · SERVICE · QUALITY
headline: Build systems that pass inspection
lead: We design, build, qualify and service Purified Water (PW), Water for Injection (WFI) and pure steam systems for plants inspected by Health Canada, FDA and EU. Each role below states its base, travel and pay.

blocks.h: What the work is, and who it suits
body: Our systems are small enough that one engineer can know the whole of one, and regulated enough that every detail is written down. You see the system you worked on pass its factory acceptance test (FAT), often with the client's quality team in the room.

Documentation is about half of every job: a weld without its log entry, or a test without its signed record, does not count. Field roles travel, and plant shutdowns fall on weekends and holidays. We say so up front because it is the main reason people leave this kind of work.
We train good documentation practice and the standards we design to. [share of team from other process industries, %]

items.a: Not for every role. Validation and quality roles need GMP experience; welders, technicians and engineers from other process industries learn it here. Everyone learns good documentation practice and the standards we design to (USP <1231>, USP <645>, USP <643>, ASME BPE, EU GMP Annex 15) on a real project file, and new engineers attend a FAT before they lead one.

items.q: I am not ASME Section IX qualified on orbital welding yet. Can I apply?
items.a: Yes, if you weld tube or pipe with GTAW. The practical interview includes a test weld on our procedure, and our welders qualify on our welding procedure specifications. [qualification offered to welders who pass, yes or no] [trainee welder positions, yes or no]
No. We assess what you have done, wherever you did it. Engineers who sign drawings must hold a licence in the province concerned; provincial regulators assess experience gained abroad.

items.q: How much do field roles really travel?
items.a: The share for each role is in the roles table and in every posting, with how travel time, meals and accommodation are paid. Shutdown work is planned [notice for planned shutdown work, weeks] ahead where the client allows.

items.q: Why does every posting show a pay range?
items.a: British Columbia has required it in public postings since 1 November 2023, and Ontario since 1 January 2026 for employers with 25 or more employees. We state it in every province because it saves both sides a call. The range is what we expect to pay for the role.
